entities.summary:
Kia Corporation (KIA Motors, originally Kyungsung Precision Industry, founded 1944 in Seoul), South Korea's second-largest automobile manufacturer after Hyundai (its parent company since 1998), has undergone one of the most remarkable brand transformations in automotive history — from being consistently ranked among the worst-regarded automotive brands in the 1990s and early 2000s to winning major automotive design and quality awards in the 2010s-2020s under chief design officer Peter Schreyer's leadership, including the 2023 World Car of the Year award for the Kia EV6.

Kia's origins were in steel tubing and bicycle manufacturing (Kyungsung Precision Industry). It began making motorcycles in 1952, trucks and cars in the 1970s, and entered the US market in 1992. Early American Kia products were plagued by quality and reliability problems; the brand was often cited in 'worst cars' rankings. The 1997 Asian financial crisis bankrupted Kia, leading Hyundai to acquire a controlling stake in 1998 — a rescue that led to the Hyundai-Kia partnership that now operates as the world's third-largest automotive group by volume.

The transformation came through design: Peter Schreyer (former Volkswagen/Audi designer) was hired in 2006 and introduced the 'tiger nose' grille identity along with cohesive design language that made Kia vehicles visually distinctive. The concurrent quality improvements — Kia and Hyundai now regularly appear at or near the top of JD Power quality surveys — have created one of automotive history's most dramatic brand rehabilitations. The EV6 and Kia's aggressive electric vehicle strategy position it among the leaders of the automotive industry's electric transition.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Kia Corporation — transformed from bankrupt Korean automaker ridiculed for poor quality to World Car of the Year winner and major EV competitor, and demonstrating how design-led strategy can rehabilitate even deeply damaged automotive brands — is one of the most remarkable industrial turnaround stories of the 21st century.
